prompt.project_info: Create a high-resolution close-up indoor mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with Korean-inspired beauty styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult East Asian woman with fair natural skin, dark-brown almond eyes, long thick lashes, jet-black shoulder-length hair with soft layers, gentle rosy makeup, and a playful confident closed-mouth smile, wearing a vintage black opaque band T-shirt with a regular-length hem and generic yellow-black graphic.
prompt.composition_elements: Phone in right hand, left hand making a small peace sign near the face, head slightly tilted, silver hoops, oversized black sunglasses on head, blurred white walls and kitchen or hallway background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused front-left window daylight, gentle shadows, slight skin glow, clean ulzzang/douyin-inspired social-media mood without public figure likeness.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution front-camera smartphone selfie, slight wide-angle distortion, sharp face, realistic eye reflections, natural hair and cotton texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-resolution close-up mirror selfie of an approved adult East Asian woman with fair natural skin, dark-brown almond eyes, long thick lashes, jet-black shoulder-length hair with soft layers and a few messy front strands, gentle rosy makeup, and a playful confident closed-mouth smile. She wears a vintage black opaque band T-shirt with a regular-length hem and a generic yellow-and-black graphic, large thin silver hoops, and oversized black rectangular sunglasses resting on her head. She holds the phone in her right hand and makes a small peace sign near her face with her left. Use a modern minimalist indoor setting with blurred white walls and a hint of kitchen or hallway, soft diffused front-left window light, slight wide-angle phone perspective, sharp face, realistic hair and cotton texture, and clean Korean-inspired social-media styling. Do not reproduce a public figure or unverified text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, 19-22 age ambiguity, cropped shirt, exposed midriff, duck face, seductive expression, nudity, readable band logo or text, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
